name: Forliuken
backstory: Child of Tamuken and Forliazco; raised in Terfila on settles the house's accounts at the market stalls..., and carries some knowledge of Gorff.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Trezco and Tamuken now have a child, Tamuzco.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Trezco and Forliamus now have a child, Forliazco.
Heard that Forliazco and Farlo now have a child, Farliazco.
Heard that Forliazco and Farmuken now have a child, Forliamuk.
Had a child with Forliarlo, named Forliukar.
Heard that Forliarlo and Tamuzco now have a child, Forliauzco.
Heard that Farliazco and Forliukar now have a child, Farliukar.

criterion.standard: counts it worthwhile only by paying real attention to Birth Of Darika
criterion.wasted_life: letting Birth Of Darika slip past unexamined, the way it's easiest to
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: makes the walk between Terfila and the crossing when there's nothing better to do at the docks, and lingers by the temple a beat longer than the walk requires.

arc.premise: Forliuken wants the story of that birth told straight at the market stalls, where it's already been garbled twice over - not settled for all time, just gotten right the next time someone tells it.
